I am examining `Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` to identify which related records the store layer deletes before removing the memo row itself.

The store layer deletes memo_relation records where this memo is the source or target, and any attachments linked to this memo, before removing the memo row itself. The API layer also deletes comments first.

Checking whether DeleteAttachment removes additional records, and whether shares or reactions are deleted at the store layer.
The store layer deletes memo_relation records where the memo is either source or target, plus any attachments linked to the memo, before deleting the memo row itself.

q16.
memo_relation (as source or target), attachments

`Store.DeleteMemo` in `store/memo.go` removes `memo_relation` rows where the memo is `memo_id` or `related_memo_id`, then attachments with that `MemoID` (`ListAttachments` / `DeleteAttachment`), and only then calls `driver.DeleteMemo` to delete the `memo` row. The API handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` also deletes comment memos first; that still goes through the same store cleanup.
